packageRules.description: Buyer-facing create-caisson scaffolds are renovate-ignored entirely (ignorePaths above): template pins are golden-file-tested (a bot bump inside a template broke packages/cli goldens — PR #227), and @caisson/* template deps resolve from registry.caisson.sh, not npm (the dashboard lookup-failure noise). Template pins move deliberately, with a BLESS=1 golden re-record in the same commit. Supersedes the Kickoff-K tag-pin-not-digest rule — under ignorePaths renovate never touches templates at all.
GitHub Actions majors are runtime-only bumps in this repo's usage — one grouped PR instead of five.
Never propose Python pre-releases (renovate offered 3.15.0b3 for .python-version).

The typescript API dep (typescript-eslint + gate tooling consumers) stays <7 until typescript-eslint publishes a >=7.0 peer range — stop reproposing it every cycle. matchDepNames (not matchPackageNames): since the ADR-0368 native-compiler cutover the repo ALSO carries the tsc-native alias dep (npm:typescript@7.0.2 in tooling/tsconfig/package.json), whose packageName resolves to "typescript" too — matchPackageNames would wrongly freeze that pin as well. tsc-native is version-managed freely; its bumps trigger the tsc-native-dts-drift.yml bump-gated PR check (ADR-0369) instead of this constraint.
